response.overview: Five Nights At Freddy's Revisited 2 is an upcoming 2026  Analog/Found Footage Horror Film edited by Fredbear Channel. The film follows Vanessa Shelly Afton (Elizabeth Lail) trapped in a coma, reliving the events of 1982. As reality and nightmares blur, her bond with Mike (Josh Hutcherson) and Abby (Piper Rubio) begins to fracture, unleashing a new terror tied to the past.
response.tagline: Two Sides Of The Same Story
response.title: Five Nights At Freddy's Revisited 2
